summary: We are seeking a motivated Python Developer to join our development team. The ideal candidate should have a strong foundation in Python programming and be excited to work on real-world projects involving web development, API creation, and performance optimization.
responsibilities: Develop, test, and maintain backend applications using Python.
Work with frameworks like Django, Flask, or FastAPI for building APIs and web services.
Write clean, maintainable, and reusable code following industry standards.
Integrate with databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB) and handle data storage solutions.
Collaborate with front-end developers and designers to deliver end-to-end solutions.
Debug, troubleshoot, and resolve bugs to improve overall performance.
Participate in software planning, documentation, and deployment processes.
required_skills: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, or relevant engineering field.
Strong understanding of Python programming and OOP concepts.
Familiarity with at least one backend framework (Django/Flask/FastAPI).
Basic knowledge of REST APIs and Version Control (Git/GitHub).
Good understanding of databases and SQL queries.
Analytical thinking and ability to solve technical problems.
nice_to_have_skills: Knowledge of JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure) or Docker.
benefits: Exposure to real-time projects and client-based development
Growth opportunities into Senior Developer or Full-Stack Developer roles
